brief:
Ed Sheeran postponed two performances scheduled at Gillette Stadium in Foxborough, Massachusetts, citing severe weather conditions. The Guardian reported the cancellations affected shows that were part of his Loop tour. The singer has not announced rescheduled dates.

The tour has drawn controversy after organizers removed rapper Macklemore from the lineup following his public statements supporting Palestinians. Sheeran's Loop tour continues through other venues.
